notes: Account: mid-market B2B SaaS — customer-facing product search + chat assistant; high emphasis on UX latency
Initial contact via product webinar (Oct 2025). Demo of Hosted API in Nov; POC kicked off Dec.
POC summary: Hosted API used for prototyping chat + embeddings. Good perf at low qps, but variability seen at higher concurrency during internal load tests.

Requirements called out on calls: P50 end-to-end latency <150ms for chat, p95 <400ms for typical sessions; embeddings batch throughput ~80 req/min; cost sensitivity at scale (aiming to keep infra delta <20% of current ML spend).
Preference: start hosted for rapid iteration, then move to Dedicated for production traffic and consistent latency. Want VPC peering and customer-managed KMS for keys.
Security procurement: need SOC2 certification evidence, DPA with EU data residency options, SSO/SAML integration for internal admin console, and per-token audit logs.

Legal asks received: explicit limitation of liability cap (requested 2x ARR), IP carveouts for user data, and standard breach-notice timelines. Our standard MSA currently differs on indemnity & warranty duration.
Pricing discussions: they responded to dedicated pricing deck 2026-01-26 — are running internal 3-way budget review (fin/infra/ops) to hit 2026 Q1 procurement target.
Quote from VP Product on 2026-01-29 call: "We need predictability — if latency jumps in production we need automatic fallback to smaller model at same API surface."
